reviewer: independent read-only G6 frozen-plan identity review

findings.title: G6 statistical analysis did not validate formal experiment, arm, and split identity fields
findings.evidence: Before this cycle, validate_statistical_inputs used group_id and the pairing dimensions but ignored experiment_id, arm_id, and split. A malformed row could therefore retain a G3/G4 key while carrying a different experiment, wrong arm label, or non-final split. The design-aligned G6 schema requires experiment_id=g6_counterfactual, arm_id corresponding to G3/G4, and the frozen formal split.
findings.remediation: Require nonempty and design-aligned experiment_id, arm_id/group_id mapping, and final_test split on every formal G6 plan row before any statistical summary. Preserve historical artifacts and do not infer scientific validity from this engineering guard.
